items.quote: I was impressed by how well the job was executed, the crew worked efficiently, maintained a clean site, and completed the project quickly. The quoting process was straightforward, and their pricing was competitive compared to other estimates I received. Communication was consistent, and I appreciated being able to follow the progress through daily photos uploaded by the site manager.

They were professional, dependable and incredibly thorough. The quality of the work was excellent. They paid close attention to the small details that made the finished roof look great. After another roofer left our home unfinished and exposed for 50+ days, this company stepped in and bailed us out. We needed a full facia and soffit. Once work began, they completed the entire roof in just four (4!) days.

Andy Ortiz broke it down to me like no other company did. He explained the different metal materials, the length of time it would take, the process, the cost involved, and answered any and all questions that I had. The crew involved in replacing my roof were efficient, thorough, and precise. They left my yard and surrounding areas cleaner than they were prior to their arrival.

Andy was incredibly knowledgeable. He inspected my roof thoroughly and explained exactly what was needed to bring everything up to code. Elvin, the project manager, was outstanding throughout the entire process, organized, attentive, and made sure every detail was handled perfectly. The entire crew was neat, respectful, and extremely clean.

Andy provided great service. He was very responsive and helpful. Communicated with me throughout the repair. Very satisfied with the work and will recommend him and his company to others. Repair was done quickly and 5 year warranty a huge plus.
